title: catalyst approve
description: What `catalyst approve <id> --json` prints: the approval's journal entry (the gate it counts toward and the exact content approved, as a path and its blob) and how many approvals the gate still needs.

files.description: Each file the entry records, with its blob before and after (null: absent).

tier.description: `chore`, `fix` or `feature`; an entry written before tiers existed may lack it.

writer.description: `catalyst/<version>`: the catalyst that wrote the entry.

gate.description: The id of the gate in `IAM/gates.json` the approval counts toward.

approved.description: The file approved and its blob: a later edit is a new version, not approved.

missing.description: The approvals the gate still needs; 0 when it is satisfied.

roles.description: With an identity provider: the approver's roles when they approved, which the gate counts (fw-IDENTITY-000004).
